note: Muscle biopsy in SNUPN-related muscular dystrophy demonstrates dystrophic changes along with myofibrillar-like and inclusion body myositis-like features linked to impaired snRNP nuclear transport.

evidence.text: Muscle histopathology in patients with SNUPN mutations showed dystrophic changes, abnormal cytoskeletal and myofibrillar proteins, and ultrastructural proliferation of granules and vesicles with nuclear envelope and sarcolemma remodelling reminiscent of inclusion body myositis.

source.title: SNUPN‐Related Muscular Dystrophy: Novel Phenotypic, Pathological and Functional Protein Insights
source.quote: The histopathology revealed dystrophic changes and an abnormal pattern of cytoskeletal and myofibrillar proteins, while electron microscopy disclosed the proliferation of granules and vesicles associated with features of nuclear envelope and sarcolemma remodelling.

evidence.text: Muscle biopsies in patients with biallelic SNUPN variants demonstrated myofibrillar-like alterations with myotilin deposits and Z-disc disorganization alongside dystrophic changes such as fibrosis and fat replacement.

source.title: Biallelic variants in SNUPN cause a limb girdle muscular dystrophy with myofibrillar-like features
source.quote: Muscle biopsy showed myofibrillar-like features consisting of myotilin deposits and Z-disc disorganization.
